acceptance_criteria: The human can see where the project is in under 20 seconds.

Claude can continue without receiving the entire ChatGPT conversation.
Work remains bound to the active objective and milestone.
Optional ideas are parked rather than implemented.
The human is interrupted only when a real choice is required.
goal_contract.current_milestone: Complete one short, reliable local control loop using ChatGPT as reviewer and Claude as executor.
goal_contract.desired_outcome: Turn a mature AI discussion into an executable project contract, keep all agents aligned with it, verify repository evidence, and involve the human only for genuine exceptions.
goal_contract.exact_next_action: Make the Goal Contract and Orientation Brief reliably reflect the current approved DogBuild purpose.
goal_contract.problem: Solo developers lose project purpose, current state, decisions, and context while moving work between ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and multiple repositories.
goal_contract.target_user: Solo developers who explore projects in ChatGPT and implement them with Claude Code or Codex.
goal_contract.why_now: The founder experiences this repeatedly while building PhotoSahi and DogBuild itself and currently acts as messenger, historian, and coordinator between AI tools.
